sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Ops Phone at 10% at the start of shift; standing by at HQ to recharge while remaining available for response calls and incidents.
Commencing Bravo Route; Ops Phone at 29%.
Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear. Patrolling up Victoria Street ensuring no issues are present.

Arrived at the Top of Victoria Street check-in; no vagrants causing any disturbances. Welfare check commenced on stores open at this time, all clear. Standing by for response calls while maintaining a strong security presence.
Continuing patrols; no issues found. Patrolling along Albert Street ensuring a strong security presence.
Welfare check commenced at Skymart Convenience Store, Formery, Sergeant Coffee and Little Albert's Coffee, all clear.
Welfare check at Hollywood Bakery, all clear. Continuing patrols down Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Customs Street and Albert Street check-in; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Welfare check at the lower Albert Street bus terminal, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough completed around the area, checked in at McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Remaining stationed here to ensure a strong security presence.
Ending standby and Bravo Route; continuing patrols.

Commencing Alpha Route; patrolling up Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence while conducting welfare checks along the way. Welfare check inside Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, finding no faults or issues.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street, no concerns identified.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street; area clear of any activity.
Welfare check at Dunkin Donuts, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Victoria Street; still no concerns visible.
Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear.
Welfare check at Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street and Mrs Higgins, all clear.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee, all clear.
Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; quick sweep completed within the area, all clear. Standing by for response calls while maintaining our presence. Ending Alpha Route.
Continuing patrols; no concerns or issues visible. Commencing Delta Route.
Arrived at the Top of Mayoral Drive check-in; area scoped out for any issues, none found.
Welfare check inside Queens Food Court and Munster Inn, all clear.
Welfare check along Rutland Street, all clear.
Welfare check at the Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street, all clear. Commencing welfare checks along the lane; water fountain on Lorne Street clear.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street and High Street; commencing check-ins on stores and businesses within the lane.
Arrived at the Chancery Square check-in; walked around the vicinity making sure no issues are present. Standing by for response calls while keeping our presence visible.
Continuing patrols and making our way to the next checkpoint.

Arrived at the Wilson Carpark check-in; area thoroughly checked for any vagrants or concerns, none identified. Checked up on the static guards, all clear. The aggressive male person of interest has not returned; advised the guards to notify us immediately if he does.

Arrived at the Bottom of Fort Street check-in; welfare check inside Sienna Cafe, Tribe Hotel, Auckland Harbour Suites, Giapo, Smiley and all stores within the allocation, all clear. Standing by to show presence while awaiting response calls.
Response call from the Cathedral Church reporting a female individual refusing to move her car from the church's disabled carpark.

Arrived at the response location and spoke with the female individual. Due to complications with the vehicle's engine not responding or turning on, she is unable to move it. She had contacted a mechanic for assistance, but due to payment issues they were unable to help. Her phone died shortly after we arrived, so we let her use the Ops Phone to call the mechanic again — still no assistance available as she could not provide payment. Called Father Graig from the Cathedral Church and explained the situation; he is now informed of the issue.
The female individual has managed to arrange help from the construction workers, but they can only assist her after work hours, most likely around 17:00.
Called Father Graig back with the information gathered; he is satisfied knowing the female individual was not refusing his request on purpose but had a mechanical issue with the vehicle.
Moving along and continuing patrols. Patrolling down Wyndham Street ensuring our presence while making quick check-ins on stores along the way.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Arrived at HQ to take our jackets off; taking a quick restroom break before continuing patrols.
Continuing patrols. Welfare check, all clear:
Welfare check on stores along Darby Street, all clear.
Welfare check commenced along Strand Arcade, all clear. Welfare check, all clear:
Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; full walkthrough completed around the area, all clear. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Call from Management requesting the Ops Phone be dropped off.
Commencing Echo Route. Welfare check at the Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived back at HQ to hand over the Ops Phone to Management.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria Street and Queen Street; commencing standby to show presence while awaiting any response.
Commencing welfare checks on Durham Street and High Street stores and businesses.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and the Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall, all clear.
Arrived at the Chancery Square check-in; full scope of the area making sure no vagrants are sleeping, all clear. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Response call from Chemist Warehouse Wyndham Street reporting a male individual involved in theft.
Continuing patrols and making our way to Management to retrieve the Ops Phone.
En route to the response call.
Arrived at the response location and asked the security guard what had happened; they suspected a male individual of stealing, but after he agreed to a bag check, nothing was found.
Heavy presence at Noel Leeming — a special sale is on, with lines of people waiting to enter.
Arrived at HQ; taking our break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:36)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Afternoon shift deployed; holding a debrief before commencing patrols.
Debrief completed, no issues; gearing up to commence patrols.
Gearing up completed; patrolling down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street with welfare checks on all stores within the area, all clear. Arrived at Britomart; commencing sweep.
Still at Britomart sweeping the area.
Call received from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male individual causing a disturbance to public peace and a staff member.
Arrived at the response location; kindly asked the individual to vacate the premises, but he refused. Awaiting the arrival of emergency services; standing by.
Police have arrived; standing by for any assistance needed.
The male individual from McDonald's Queen Street has been taken in; providing details and statements to Police.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street; Police assistance no longer required. Commencing welfare checks in the area.
Removed a group of vagrants taking shelter in front of the Titanic memorial, as requested by staff; all clear.
Welfare check, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Queen Street:
Welfare check on stores from Mecca and Farmers down to OPSM and Hallensteins, all clear, no issues. Standing by at JB Hi-Fi due to the heavy presence in the area.
Welfare check at JB Hi-Fi and with staff, all clear, no issues. Patrolling to Vulcan Lane.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane with welfare checks on all stores, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on High Street, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Shortland Street; welfare check at North Face, Taco Bell, Shortland Mart, Corner Bar and Haven Mart, all clear. Patrolling down the Fort Lane area.

Full sweep of Fort Lane; welfare check at KFC, UGG, Hoka, Evan's Kebab, Vape Haven, Right Track, Jo & Joes, Mr Murdochs and the Fort Street carpark, all clear. Maintaining presence at Jo & Joes due to a big event being hosted.
Maintaining presence at Jo & Joes for the event (17:40 – 18:00).
Welfare check at Jo & Joes, all clear, no issues. Heading back to Headquarters to commence floor checks.
Floor checks completed. Call received from a fellow guard at Elliott Stables notifying us of a large gathering of Police in the area; en route to provide any assistance.
Arrived at the location; Police services are still in the area. Maintaining presence.
No longer needed for Police assistance; continuing patrols.
Arrived at Elliott Stables; standing by maintaining presence.
Welfare check at Elliott Stables, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Wellesley Street.
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check at the Lorne Street staircase and mural, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of the whole of Lorne Street; welfare check on all remaining open businesses, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing a 30-minute break.
Call received from Management to attend 205 Queen Street and ask all vagrants there to leave the premises.
Situation dealt with, no issues; heading back to HQ to continue the break.
Arrived at Headquarters; continuing the break (20:10 – 20:32).
Afternoon shift completed; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. (All photos and videos provided at the end of the shift.)
Night shift deployed; holding a debrief before commencing patrols.
Debrief completed; charging the Ops Phone before commencing full patrols.
Standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone (22:05 – 23:06).
Charging completed; gearing up and commencing patrols.
Full sweep of Elliott Street; welfare check at Wilson Carpark, Domino's, Burger Express, Smashed Potatoes, Mr Snack, Chicken n Chips n Fish and Bar 101, all clear. Patrolling to Red Radisson.
Arrived at Red Radisson; commencing welfare checks.
Welfare check at Red Radisson and the AKA Rooftop Bar, all clear, no issues.
Conducted a full sweep of the whole of Lorne Street; welfare check at Meet Fresh, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.
Conducting the sweep at Freyberg Place.
Full sweep conducted at Freyberg Place; patrolling down High Street.
Full sweep of High Street, no issues. Standing by at Mothership.
Welfare check at Mothership and Shortland Mart, all clear, no issues.
Call received from the Kong manager requesting assistance to remove a male vagrant whose behaviour was out of control.
Arrived at the location and approached the male vagrant; politely asked him to move along. He responded with some attitude but was successfully moved along without any further issues.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check with the Kemuri guard and staff, all clear. Standing by at Reign & Pour.
Welfare check at Reign & Pour and with the guards, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Quay Street.
Quay Street all clear, no issues. Arrived at the Viaduct; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of the Viaduct; welfare check at Lulas Sweatshop, Danny Doolans, Rosie's Hot Cantina and with all guards, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Quay Street.
While making our way down Quay Street, observed a large number of Police vehicles in the area; standing by for any further issues.
Standing down from the area; welfare check at Take 10 and with the guard, all clear.
Welfare check on Quay Street, all clear. Patrolling up Lower Albert Street.
Lower Albert Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Supermart, all clear.
Albert Street all clear, no issues. Patrolling through Swanson Street.
Swanson Street all clear, no issues. Arrived at Federal Square; commencing sweep.
Still conducting the sweep at Federal Square.
Full sweep of Federal Square; welfare check at Indingo, the Cathedral and Liston House, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at Ace Karaoke Bar, all clear. Patrolling down Wyndham Street.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street, no issues. Patrolling up Queen Street.
Queen Street all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling to Bar 101.
Arrived at Bar 101; standing by maintaining presence until closing.
Bar 101 has closed; standing by until the crowd clears out to ensure no issues.
Crowd from Bar 101 has fully cleared; patrolling up to Victoria Street.
Welfare check on Victoria Street and at Skymart Convenience Store, all clear. Patrolling down Albert Street.
Full sweep of Albert Street; welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Lower Albert Street.
Lower Albert Street all clear, no issues to report.
Quay Street all clear, no issues to report. Arrived at Britomart; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear.
The whole of Customs Street all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Fort Street; welfare check at Wilson Carpark and Jo & Joes, all clear, no issues. Patrolling to High Street.
Welfare check on Shortland Street, all clear. Patrolling up High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place; welfare check on O'Connell Street and Chancery Street, all clear. Heading back to Headquarters to commence a 30-minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters; taking a 30-minute break.
Break completed; waiting in the office for guard handover while responding to any calls that occur.
Night shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.

flags: CAPACITY: 13:20 Chemist Warehouse Wyndham Street theft call — the team first detoured to Management to retrieve the Ops Phone (13:35) before routing to the call (13:40), arriving 13:47, approximately 27 minutes after the call.
CAPACITY: Morning patrols did not commence until 07:00 — Ops Phone was at 10% at shift start and the team held at HQ to recharge it (available for calls only).
CAPACITY: Night Shift full patrols did not commence until 23:06 — debrief until 21:53 then Ops Phone charging at HQ (22:05 – 23:06), team available for calls only during this window.
